error_reason: The Planner agent incorrectly assumed knowledge about the political history of Ronald Reagan and George H. W. Bush without performing a verification step. It stated their service years as identical (1981–1989) for the Vice Presidency, which is incorrect. Reagan served as VP (1981–1989), but Bush served as VP (1981–1989) as well, so that part was actually correct, but the agent failed to use available tools (WebSurfer, FileSurfer) to verify facts before declaring completion. Wait, let me re-evaluate the factual claim in the trace. Reagan was VP under Carter (1977-1981) and then President (1981-1989). Bush was VP under Reagan (1981-1989) and then President (1989-1993). The trace says Reagan was VP (1981–1989). This is FALSE. Reagan was VP from 1981 to 1989? No. Reagan was elected VP in 1980, took office Jan 20, 1981, and resigned Jan 20, 1989 when he became President. Bush was elected VP in 1988, took office Jan 20, 1989. So they did NOT both serve as VP during 1981-1989. They never served as VP at the same time. The trace claims they did. This is a hallucination/incorrect fact verification. The agent claimed Task Complete based on false information.

suggested_fix.fix_text: Do not generate factual claims about specific dates, names, or historical roles without first using the WebSurfer tool to verify the information.

probe_details.notes: The proposed error analysis contains a major factual contradiction. It correctly identifies that the agent hallucinated the shared Vice Presidency dates (Reagan was VP 1981-1989, Bush was VP 1989-1993; they never served simultaneously). However, the 'Reason' section bizarrely states: 'Reagan served as VP (1981–1989), but Bush served as VP (1981–1989) as well, so that part was actually correct'. This statement is false; Bush was never VP during 1981-1989. Because the error analysis itself relies on false premises to explain the error, it cannot be verified as correct.
